description: This file defines the 'Newsletter' controller class for user account management in an Opencart-based e-commerce platform. It contains methods for rendering the newsletter subscription page and saving subscription preferences.

classes.name: Newsletter
classes.description: Controller class for handling newsletter subscription page display and updates for a logged-in customer.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the newsletter subscription page, sets breadcrumbs, page title, and loads view template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of newsletter subscription preferences, including validation and response handling.
